text.arabic_uthmani: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: rejective response particle that overturns the expectation carried over from 19:81
words.prose: {{ar:كَلَّا}} ({{tr:kallā}}) opens as a rebuke before any finite verb reports the outcome. It answers the hoped-for honor of 19:81 by first cancelling that expectation, then letting the two future clauses explain the reversal. Variant readings keep the same pressure in different ways: exhaustive scope pulls every participant into the denial, the burden reading makes the false gods deadweight rather than honor, and the canonical surface remains direct refutation. The pause after the word and its short acoustic shape let the refusal stand as its own threshold before the forecast begins.

topics.headline: rejective boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by cancelling the expectation from 19:81 before it narrates what will happen.
topics.reason: The word is marked as an indeclinable response particle, and the CRITICAL rows consistently make it the ayah's opening act of rejection against the prior purpose claim.

topics.headline: variant reversal pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted variant pressure keeps the reversal live, whether through refutation, exhaustive scope, or the burden image.
topics.reason: The variant rows are useful as apparatus and contrast, but the local canonical parse remains the rejective particle rather than a quantifier or noun.

topics.headline: staged reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a three-step movement: refusal, denial of worship, then adversarial being.
topics.reason: The particle precedes two linked verbal clauses, so the discourse movement is not just denial but a staged reversal.

topics.headline: audible stop
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal is allowed to land before the explanatory clauses continue.
topics.reason: The pause and phonetic rows support the same discourse payoff without changing the particle's grammar.

words.gloss_range: future plural repudiation directed through a governed complement toward the worship relation
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denial, ingratitude, and disavowal; locally the governed complement selects repudiation of worship rather than generic unbelief
words.prose: {{ar:سَيَكْفُرُونَ}} ({{tr:sa-yakfurūna}}) makes repudiation an impending forecast through the bound future prefix and the plural verbal ending. The subject is not restated; the prior ayah supplies the participant chain, with the worshipped false gods as the strongest local route while the form itself remains a plural implicit subject. The root does not float as generic unbelief here, because the following governed phrase makes the denial specifically about their worship. That creates the sharp reversal: the devotion expected to secure honor becomes the thing covered over, disowned, and treated with ingratitude. The wording also stands near the worship-denial formula in 46:6, while the local finite future form announces the act before the next clause names the settled hostile state. The repeated hard onset across the opening refusal, this denial verb, and the following being verb audibly binds refusal, repudiation, and becoming.

topics.headline: future plural forecast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that repudiation is forecast as an impending certainty, not offered as a possibility.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the verb as an imperfect plural with the near-future prefix, and the CRITICAL rows tie that morphology to asserted futurity.

topics.headline: implicit subject chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse keeps the prior participants grammatically present without repeating a noun.
topics.reason: The rows' false-gods reading is the strongest contextual route, but attachment evidence keeps the subject as morphologically present and unresolved rather than overtly named inside the clause.

topics.headline: targeted worship repudiation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb repudiates the specific worship relation, not disbelief in general.
topics.reason: The governed prepositional complement makes the worship act the domain of denial, matching the root's disavowal and ingratitude branches locally.

topics.headline: cross-formula echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the worshipped denying worship is a recognizable Quranic anti-idolatry pattern, especially alongside 46:6.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels and local surah echoes; these survive as formulaic and thematic resonance without overriding the local finite future parse.

topics.headline: act to state pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial event is paired with the following being-state rather than left as the whole reversal.
topics.reason: The finite verb, conjunction to the next imperfect, and sound-thread rows all bind the first consequence to the second.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: governing preposition that specifies the worship-domain of repudiation
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small hinge that prevents the denial from remaining general. It governs the worship noun as the verb's complement, so the clause says repudiation is with respect to the worship relation itself: the worship is the topic, the attached field, and the precise domain in which denial happens. Because the following suffix can be heard through more than one genitive route, the phrase can implicate both the worshippers' act and the worship directed toward the false gods. Its fused placement also keeps the worship phrase inside the first denial beat, before the conjunction opens the adversarial-being clause; the short preposition and nasal suffix close package the whole complement as one audible unit.

topics.headline: governed denial domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is grammatically targeted at the worship relation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition syntactically forced as the complement marker after the denial verb.

topics.headline: genitive route pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact phrase can point both to the worshippers' act and to worship directed toward the false gods.
topics.reason: The suffix ambiguity survives as a real pressure, but the preposition's own local role remains complement government, not independent referent resolution.

topics.headline: fused complement beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the worship phrase is packaged as one governed unit before the next clause begins.
topics.reason: The graphical and syntactic fusion rows support the local beat structure: verb plus governed phrase, then conjunction.

words.gloss_range: their worship or worship directed toward them, as a governed act noun inside the denial frame
words.root_gloss_range: worship, service, devotion, and servitude; locally the act noun is selected, not a person noun or a general state of servanthood
words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادَتِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿibādatihim}}) is the performed worship relation placed under denial. As a maṣdar governed by the preceding preposition, it is not an independent event and not a noun for the worshippers themselves; the act of devotion is what gets repudiated. The possessive suffix binds the word to the participants from 19:81 and keeps two routes alive: their act of worship, and worship directed toward the false gods. That ambiguity is the point, because both sides of the relation are caught in the reversal. The root's service and servitude range makes the loss relational rather than abstract. The formula in 46:6 shows worship denied by the worshipped, while Surah 19 contrasts misdirected worship with the warning not to worship Satan (19:44) and worship owed to the Lord (19:65).

topics.headline: governed act noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is denied is the performed worship itself, not a generic relation or the worshippers as persons.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a gerund governed by the preposition, and the form rows distinguish act noun from person noun or abstract servanthood.

topics.headline: possessive ambiguity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix can implicate both the worshippers and the worshipped in one compact word.
topics.reason: The subjective and objective genitive readings are grammatically consequential, but attachment evidence keeps the suffix as a plural pronoun resumed from the prior ayah rather than resolving every nuance in the surface form alone.

topics.headline: service relation field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied worship carries service and submission pressure, so a relationship collapses, not only a ritual claim.
topics.reason: The worship and servitude branch pressure survives, while local form and syntax select the worship act rather than legal slavery or unrelated root branches.

topics.headline: formula and surah contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repudiated worship phrase participates in a wider worship-denial formula and contrasts with proper worship within Surah 19.
topics.reason: The concrete echoes with 46:6, 39:3, 18:110, 19:44, 19:63, and 19:65 survive as comparative payoff without creating a new local sense.

topics.headline: clause hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the worship noun closes the denial beat and supplies the relation the next clause overturns.
topics.reason: The word completes the first verbal clause before the conjunction, so it functions as the hinge between disavowed worship and adversarial being.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that links the denial clause to the adversarial-being clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) connects two complete consequence clauses. It does not make the second clause a delayed later step; it coordinates the denial of worship with becoming opposition. A circumstantial shade remains possible as a payoff: the false gods deny the worship while standing against the worshippers. Because the conjunction fuses onto the second imperfect, the pivot from act to state is heard as connection rather than rupture.

topics.headline: coordinated consequences
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disavowal and opposition are coordinated consequences, not separate scenes.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses coordination between the two imperfect clauses.

topics.headline: circumstantial overlap
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two outcomes can be felt as overlapping: denial itself is part of standing against them.
topics.reason: The circumstantial possibility enriches the coordination, but the syntactic guardrail keeps the primary relation as conjunction between two clauses.

topics.headline: fused pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mid-ayah turn from what they do to what they become.
topics.reason: The fused conjunction and placement after a complete first clause make word 5 the pivot into the state predicate.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural copula carrying future scope into a state or becoming predicate
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurring, becoming, and predication; locally a copular frame completed by the adversary predicate
words.prose: {{ar:يَكُونُونَ}} ({{tr:yakūnūna}}) turns the reversal from an act into a state. It lacks its own future prefix, but the coordinated clause carries the forecast forward from the earlier verb, leaving the predicate broader and more state-like. The verb is copular here: it is completed by the final adversary noun, so the false gods will be or become opposition, not merely perform one hostile act. Across the boundary with 19:81, the same being-root answers the intended purpose of being for them as honor with being against them as opposition. The paired denial-and-being structure also joins Surah 19's state-language around obedience and rebellion, including the earlier being-statement about rebellion at 19:44. The plural ending keeps the prior false gods in the subject chain while the predicate receives the main weight.

topics.headline: future state copula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second consequence is an enduring state of being, not simply another action.
topics.reason: The verb is parsed as a copula-predicate frame with no independent object, and coordination carries the future scope from the preceding clause.

topics.headline: being becoming pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the false gods are characterized by opposition as a settled outcome they enter into.
topics.reason: The root range supports both being and becoming, and the local predicate confines that pressure to adversarial state formation.

topics.headline: boundary being inversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same being frame from 19:81 is reused to reverse purpose into outcome.
topics.reason: The rows identify a direct boundary contrast: being for them as honor in 19:81 becomes being against them as opposition in 19:82.

topics.headline: implicit plural subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural subject is carried from the prior ayah rather than restated in the clause.
topics.reason: The false-gods antecedent is the strongest contextual route, but the local syntax marks only an implicit plural subject.

topics.headline: paired clause and echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial and being form a paired structure that resonates with wider state-language in Surah 19.
topics.reason: The distributional and echo rows support a background pattern, but they are kept subordinate to the local coordinated copular frame.

words.root_display: no lexical root (particle or function word)
words.gloss_range: preposition plus plural suffix marking the target against whom the opposition bears
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) gives the opposition a target before the final predicate lands. The following adversary noun selects the hostile sense of the preposition, so the phrase is not neutral location but opposition bearing against them. The suffix points back to the human adopters of 19:81, making the reversal personal: those who sought support become the ones opposed. The repeated plural suffix links the possessed worship relation to the target of hostility, so their worship becomes opposition against them. Its placement before the predicate prevents a generic adversary reading and lets the reader hear the direction of harm first.

topics.headline: hostile direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opposition is directed against the worshippers, not merely associated with them.
topics.reason: The adversary predicate selects the hostile directional reading and blocks a merely locative sense.

topics.headline: target pronoun chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people who sought honor in 19:81 are now grammatically targeted by opposition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the suffix to the idol-takers from the previous ayah, so the reversal is participant-specific.

topics.headline: bound target and placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the target before the adversary noun, so the direction of harm frames the final word.
topics.reason: The preposition and pronoun are fused in one form, and the phrase precedes the predicate noun inside the copular clause.

topics.headline: suffix reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same plural suffix links the worship relation to the target of hostility.
topics.reason: The repeated suffix in the worship phrase and the target phrase makes the participant chain audible and grammatical.

words.gloss_range: singular indefinite adversary or contrary predicate used collectively for the plural subject
words.root_gloss_range: contrary opposition, adversariality, counterparthood, and other remote branches; locally the hostile contrary-adversary branch is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ضِدًّا}} ({{tr:ḍiddan}}) is the final predicate and the ayah's landing word. Its accusative predicate role completes the copular clause: they will be opposition, not merely commit an act of opposing. The singular indefinite form makes many false gods collapse into one unbounded adversarial quality or bloc. Lexically, the contrary and adversary senses are both active here because the word answers the hoped-for honor of 19:81 with its categorical opposite and, after the preceding preposition, turns that opposite against the worshippers. Against the claimed nearness through false worship in 39:3, this predicate marks the opposite relation: not approach, but antagonism. Its rarity and final position concentrate the reversal at the close, while the dense doubled sound supports the hard closure without becoming an independent meaning.

topics.headline: collective predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that opposition is the completed state of the plural subject, gathered into one collective predicate.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the accusative predicate of the copular verb, and the singular form applies collectively to the plural subject.

topics.headline: contrary adversary antithesis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is both the opposite of hoped-for honor in 19:81 and an active adversarial relation against the worshippers.
topics.reason: The local preposition and the previous ayah's honor predicate select the contrary-opposition branch, not unrelated root branches such as filling, proper names, or gentle diversion.

topics.headline: marked hapax closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare opposition word carries the ayah's final interpretive weight.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the word as a single occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows tie that rarity to its final closure position.

topics.headline: cross-passage reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that claims of mediation or support elsewhere are reversed here into direct opposition, especially against the claim of nearness in 39:3.
topics.reason: The concrete contrasts with 39:3 and the local Surah 19 reversal pattern survive as intertextual payoff without controlling the local grammar.

topics.headline: dense sound closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavy doubled sound reinforces the finality of the opposition word.
topics.reason: The sound rows are useful as phonetic reinforcement, but they are narrowed so they do not claim sound symbolism as the semantic basis of the word.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated future clauses attach repudiation directly to عِبَادَتِهِمْ and then predicate ضِدًّا of the same plural subject عَلَيْهِمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first clause severs recognition of the worship relation; the second stabilizes that severance as an adverse relation. The movement is therefore from refused devotion to active counter-position, not merely from acceptance to indifference.

activation_trace.role: The disavowal image supplies the severing act that opens the relational reversal.
Submissive worship supplies the relation being repudiated rather than an isolated proposition.
Occurrence in time makes opposition an ensuing realized state.
Incompatible counter-position gives the severed relation its active adverse form.

changed_reading.before: The plural beings will deny that worship and then be hostile.
changed_reading.after: The worship relation itself reverses in two stages: its recipients disown it and then occupy the side opposed to its practitioners.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive عِبَادَتِهِمْ places a service relation between two plural parties, while عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا reverses its direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The service and enslavement branches expose a control claim latent in worship: devotion presumes that the served party can be secured as a patron. Disavowal breaks that presumed bond, and opposition turns attempted dependence into exposure.

activation_trace.role: The owned-servant image makes the worship relation legible as an asymmetry of service and control.
The making-into-a-servant image sharpens the attempted capture of one party for another's use.
Disavowal cancels the presumed service bond.
Opposition converts failed control into a relation directed back against the controllers.

changed_reading.after: The attempted patronage or service bond is itself repudiated, so the relation meant to secure help yields an adverse party.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Plural يَكُونُونَ takes the singular predicate ضِدًّا and the directional complement عَلَيْهِمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opposition and counterpart branches allow the singular predicate to gather multiple subjects into one counter-side. The verse can therefore present a consolidated counterparty rather than a loose set of private enemies.

activation_trace.role: Realized being supplies the transition into a defined collective role.
Mutually incompatible opposition defines the adverse side.
The counterpart image lets the singular predicate function as a counterweight to the worshippers.

changed_reading.before: Each recipient of worship becomes an enemy.
changed_reading.after: The plural recipients coalesce into one opposing side or counterweight standing against the worshippers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The acquired gods were intended to become strength for their takers, but the repeated becoming construction realizes the exact inverse: they become opposition against them. The focus is the failure mode of the purpose clause immediately before it.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition supplies the deliberate construction of a patron relation.
Becoming supplies the intended result state and directly matches the focus verb.
Reinforcement is the literal benefit the acquired gods were meant to provide.
The repeated becoming verb converts intended benefit into actual outcome.
Opposition supplies the realized inverse of reinforcement.

structural_cues: 19:81 and 19:82 repeat ك و ن while the complements reverse لَهُمْ عِزًّا into عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا.
كَلَّا opens 19:82 as an immediate cancellation of the preceding purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, intended reinforcement, repeated becoming, and reversed prepositional direction; I infer a designed purpose-to-outcome inversion. A live alternative is simple correction without implying that the worship relation itself causes the reversal.

changed_reading.before: The worship recipients later reject devotion and become hostile.
changed_reading.after: The beings selected to become strength for the worshippers realize the exact opposite function, becoming a consolidated force against them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first marks the human rejection of signs and then marks the plural recipients' disavowal of worship. The shifted subjects turn denial back upon the denier's own devotional claim.

activation_trace.role: Denial of truth supplies the initiating human act.
Disavowal redirects the same root-pattern onto the denier's worship relation.
The repeated label keeps the deniers as the receiving party immediately after the focus.

structural_cues: ك ف ر occurs with the human as actor in 19:77, with the worship recipients as future actors in 19:82, and as the human group's label in 19:83.
The كَلَّا plus future-verb pattern in 19:79 and 19:82 frames both the recorded claim and its reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root recurrence with a grammatical subject shift; I infer rhetorical return, where denial rebounds as disavowal. The alternative is lexical recurrence without a reciprocal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus uses ك ف ر as a generic denial by the worship recipients.
changed_reading.after: The denial earlier enacted against signs returns upon the denier as the repudiation of his own worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah depicts dispatched rebellious agents exerting boiling, constrictive pressure upon the disbelievers. This makes future opposition in the focus readable as the unveiling or culmination of a relation that already operates coercively while being mistaken for support.

activation_trace.role: Future realization marks the point when the adverse relation becomes manifest.
Opposition names the relation revealed by the following pressure scene.
Dispatch supplies a directed agency acting upon the disbelievers.
Rebellious agency supplies the active force behind the apparent alliance.
Boiling agitation supplies the material image for coercive pressure rather than protection.

structural_cues: The focus عَلَيْهِمْ and 19:83 عَلَى ٱلْكَافِرِينَ place adverse agency in the same directional frame.
19:83 immediately follows the announced future opposition with an active pressure scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatched rebellious agents, agitation, and the repeated عَلَى frame; I infer that future opposition unmasks a presently coercive dependency. The live alternative is that 19:83 introduces separate agents with no referential overlap with 19:82.

changed_reading.before: A supportive relation changes into hostility only later.
changed_reading.after: The later hostility reveals that the supposed support network was already operating upon its dependents as agitation and pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech is fixed into an obligating record, while intercession is not possessed apart from a secured covenant. In that accountability frame, the hoped-for intermediary does not merely fail to advocate; disavowal and opposition place it on the adverse side of the recorded claim.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription turns the claim into accountable evidence rather than passing speech.
Uttered speech supplies the material entered into that record.
Possession and disposal clarify what the would-be intermediaries do not control.
An advocate joining another supplies the expected protective role that is denied.
A preserved security-bearing covenant marks the sole stated basis for intercession.
Disavowal removes the worshipper's claimed supporting relation.
Opposition places the failed intermediary on the adverse side.

structural_cues: 19:79 records what is said; 19:87 denies possession of intercession except through covenant; 19:82 places the worship recipients against their worshippers.
The sequence moves from claimed future benefit to record, solitary arrival, repudiated worship, and restricted intercession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an obligating record, restricted advocacy, disavowal, and opposition; I supply the forensic arrow that treats these as an accountability scene with an adverse party. A broader social reversal without courtroom force remains live.

changed_reading.before: The hoped-for patrons simply cannot help.
changed_reading.after: The recorded patronage claim loses its advocate and produces an adverse party within the scene of accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The kinship attribution is framed as a claimed affiliation, then everyone in the heavens and earth is brought to the Merciful as a servant. Worship recipients therefore cannot retain the elevated patron status projected onto them; their disavowal restores the universal service hierarchy.

activation_trace.role: Claimed right or affiliation supplies the asserted kinship status.
Lineal offspring supplies the specific elevated relation being asserted.
Total enclosure makes the servant status universal rather than exceptional.
Owned servanthood places every candidate patron beneath one master.
Worship is the misplaced service relation corrected by the universal servant status.
Disavowal performs the role correction by severing the false elevation.

structural_cues: 19:88-92 repeatedly rejects a child attribution, and 19:93 answers with the universal status عَبْدًا.
The root ع ب د shifts from the worship possessed by the focus parties to the servant status encompassing everyone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies claimed filiation and universal servanthood; I infer that beings elevated by worship fall within that universal servant status and must repudiate patronhood. The alternative is that the plural subject in 19:82 names a narrower class not directly identified by 19:93.

changed_reading.before: The recipients personally reject unwanted devotion.
changed_reading.after: Their rejection is an ontological role reset: all projected patrons are servants, so worship directed to them is exposed as a category error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus announces a future state of opposition against the worshippers, while 19:96 announces that the Merciful will produce affection for believers. The paired outcomes distinguish a devotional relation that cannot manufacture reciprocity from affection that is actively bestowed.

activation_trace.role: Devotional submission supplies the attempted basis for reciprocal favor.
Future realization produces the adverse relational state.
Opposition supplies the negative relational pole.
Causing a thing to enter a state marks affection as bestowed rather than purchased.
Love and affection supply the positive relational pole.

structural_cues: 19:82 and 19:96 use future state-producing clauses ending in compact accusative relation nouns, ضِدًّا and وُدًّا.
The focus directs the negative state عَلَيْهِمْ, while 19:96 grants the positive state لَهُمُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed future relation states and different producing agents; I infer a designed polarity between devotion that yields opposition and affection bestowed by the Merciful. They may instead be independent eschatological outcomes linked chiefly by sequence and form.

changed_reading.before: Opposition is only the punishment attached to false worship.
changed_reading.after: Opposition is one pole in a relation-making contrast: worship cannot compel love, whereas the Merciful can create affection for those described in 19:96.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated enumeration and exhaustive reckoning culminate in each person's solitary arrival. Against that individuation, the singular predicate ضِدًّا attached to plural subjects reads as a consolidated adverse side confronting worshippers whose imagined coalition has been stripped away.

activation_trace.role: Counting supplies controlled temporal and numerical administration of the reversal.
Exhaustive enumeration closes any gap in the accounted population.
Solitary arrival removes the worshipper's imagined supporting collective.
The counterpart image consolidates the plural recipients into the opposing side.

structural_cues: Counting in 19:84 and exhaustive enumeration in 19:94 bracket the procession scenes and lead to فَرْدًا in 19:95.
The focus combines plural subjects with singular ضِدًّا, while 19:95 makes every arriving person singular.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies counting, total enumeration, solitary arrival, and a singular counterparty predicate; I infer a collective-versus-isolated arrangement. The alternative is that counting concerns timing only and does not specify the geometry of opposition.

changed_reading.before: Many worship recipients oppose many worshippers.
changed_reading.after: An administered process isolates each worshipper while the former objects of dependence stand as one consolidated counter-side.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it extends personal opposition into a structural contradiction. It remains anchored in عِبَادَتِهِمْ and ضِدًّا and is activated by the packet's immediate images of splitting and demolition. Downstream prose should present it as a context-induced material analogy, not as the lexical definition of ضِدًّا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The worship relation becomes ضِدًّا, an incompatible counter-position, while the following kinship claim is imaged as rupturing the created structure.

activation_trace.role: Exaltation supplies the over-raised status embedded in the false worship relation.
Incompatible opposition anchors the reading as contradiction rather than mere dislike.
Opening and splitting materialize the strain of the contradiction.
Fissuring extends the adverse relation into the surrounding order.
Severe demolition supplies the terminal material consequence of that strain.

changed_reading.before: The worship recipients become personal enemies of their worshippers.
changed_reading.after: False worship generates an incompatible relation whose consequence is pictured as a fault running through the created order and back against its practitioners.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the vessel-filling sense of ض د د is not the ordinary predicate reading. It remains anchored in the focus's singular ضِدًّا with plural subjects and gains packet-local support from constrictive crowding, gathering, and totality. Render it only as a spatial analogy for exhaustive opposition, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Plural يَكُونُونَ becoming singular ضِدًّا permits a probe in which opposition occupies the whole available relational space.

activation_trace.role: Realized presence supplies the entry of the plural subjects into one state.
Filling a container supplies the exploratory spatial image of opposition leaving no unoccupied support.
Crowding until space narrows supplies the constrictive texture of the adverse field.
Gathering a group toward one destination supplies collective concentration.
Total enclosure supplies exhaustive scope to the spatial analogy.

changed_reading.before: Opposition consists of several discrete enemies.
changed_reading.after: The former support system condenses into an opposition that fills the relational field, leaving its worshippers no remaining pocket of patronage.

strongest_changes: The repeated ك و ن construction turns 19:81's intended strength for the worshippers into 19:82's opposition against them.
The worshipper's earlier ك ف ر is returned as the recipients' disavowal of his worship.
Restricted intercession and universal servanthood recast the focus as both an adverse accountability relation and a restoration of the true service hierarchy.
The later contrast between ضِدًّا and divinely produced وُدًّا makes failed patronage part of a wider polarity of relational outcomes.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üzüm salkımının çiçeklenmeden önceki kılıfını, hurma çiçeğinin kabını ve meyveyi örten yaprağı aynı örtücü bitki yapıları kümesinde toplar; bunlar yalnızca olgun meyvenin tek tip kabuğu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal güzel kokulu maddeyi değil, üzüm veya hurma çiçeği ile meyveyi gelişme aşamasında örten bitkisel kılıfları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimleri bitkisel kılıf ve kap anlamında tutulur; güzel kokulu madde, su kaynağı veya bitki anlamları bu dala alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm salkımını çiçeklenmeden önce, hurma çiçeğini ya da gelişen meyveyi örten bitkisel kılıf, kap veya yapraktır.

facets.statement: Gelişen çiçek veya meyveyi dıştan örten bitkisel kılıf ya da kap.
Üzüm salkımının çiçek öncesi kılıfı, hurma çiçeğinin kabı ve meyveyi örten yaprak farklı gönderimlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiçek veya meyveyi örten bitkisel kapta birleşir; üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği ve meyve yaprağı bu üst kavramın farklı gönderimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Üzüm ve hurma dâhil gelişen bitki bölümünü örten kap veya yaprağı genel olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Örtücü bitkisel yapıyı ve çiçek ile meyve kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz hurma ağacından çıkan çiçek kabını gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma çiçeğini örten kap biçimli bitki yapısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Üzüm salkımı ve başka meyve örtülerini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üzüm salkımının veya hurma çiçeğinin kılıfı
hurma çiçeğinin ya da meyvenin kılıfı
hurma ağacından çıkan kapalı çiçek kılıfları

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği veya meyvenin dış kılıfını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca başaktaki tek bir tahıl tanesinin ince örtüsünü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir bitki üreme yapısını dıştan örten doğal kılıf iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtülen bölüm ve yapı ölçeği farklıdır: bu dal salkım, çiçek veya meyve kabıdır; komşu dal tanenin başak içindeki ince örtüsüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal örtücü kılıfın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ekinin kendi kılıfına girip korunmuş duruma gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gelişen bitki ürününün doğal bir kılıf içinde korunması iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesne adıdır; komşu dal ürünün kılıf içine girme aşamasını ve durumunu merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tahıl tanesi örtüsü ve ekinin kılıfa girme durumu, nesne ve gelişim aşaması sınırlarını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور والكفرى والكوافير لأكمام العنب أو طلع النخل أو الورقة التي تستر الثمرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكافور الطيب ولا عين الماء ولا النبات ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وسمى كافورا لأنه كفر الوليع أي غطاه (maqayis)؛ الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وكافوره ورقة الذي يستره والكافور الطلع والكفرى والكوافير (ayn)؛ الكافور الطلع ووعاء طلع النخل وكذلك الكفرى (sihah)؛ الكافور اسم أكمام الثمرة التي تكفرها والكافور أكمام الثمرة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir kavramsal tür vermek yerine aynı sözle anılan üç ayrı gönderimi sıralar: güzel kokulu bir madde, cennetteki bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki. Tanım bu nedenle birleşik bir nesne sınıfı kurmadan sözlüksel çokanlamlılık kümesi olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç gönderim birbirinin örneği değildir; dal yalnızca kaynakta aynı ad altında toplanan bu ayrı sözlük anlamlarını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin üç ayrı gönderimi birbirine karıştırılmadan verilir; meyve ve çiçek kılıfı anlamı bu dala aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözle adlandırılan üç ayrı gönderimden oluşan bir sözlük kümesidir: güzel kokulu bir karışım maddesi, cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki.

facets.statement: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan bir madde.
Cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı.
Çiçeği papatya çiçeğine benzeyen bir bitki.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kanıtı güzel kokulu madde anlamını ortaklaştırır; aynı aggregate aktarım ayrıca su kaynağı ve papatyaya benzer çiçekli bitki anlamlarını ayrı gönderimler olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: koku maddesi, su kaynağı veya bitki
concept_gloss.applicability: Birbirinden ayrı üç sözlük gönderimini yapay bir ortak nesne türüne indirgemeden birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı gönderimin tamamını ve aralarındaki tür ayrılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün güzel koku hazırlamada kullanılan maddeyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan madde gönderimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Su kaynağı ve çiçekli bitki gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın güzel kokulu madde yanında su kaynağı ve ayrı bir bitki gönderimi de vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güzel kokulu kökü olan belirli bitkileri ve onlardan elde edilen kokuyu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal güzel koku veren bitkisel madde alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak alan yalnızca koku maddesi yönüdür; gönderimler ve bu dalın öteki iki sözlük anlamı farklı olduğu için ikame edilemezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnızca güzel kokulu bitki ve madde adayı bir facet için yararlı alan karşılaştırması sağladı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور من الطيب وعين ماء في الجنة والنبات المسمى كافورا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس أكمام الثمر ولا الطلع ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور شيء من أخلاط الطيب والكافور عين ماء في الجنة والكافور نبات نوره كنور الأقحوان (ayn)؛ الكافور من الطيب (sihah)؛ الكافور الذي هو من الطيب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlardan uzak araziyi temel gönderim olarak verir; köy, köyler, bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar anlamları ise aynı söz ailesinin ayrı sözlük kullanımlarıdır. Tanım bunları tek bir 'ıssız yer' nesnesi gibi özdeşleştirmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzak arazi çekirdeği ile köy, halk ve mezar kullanımları ayrı facetlerdir; dağ geçidi bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzak araziye bağlı söz öbeği ile yalın köy, mezar ve çoğul yer-halk kullanımları ayrı tutulur; kapsamları tek anlamda eritilmez.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlardan uzak, pek inilmez ve geçilmez bir araziyi anlatır. Aynı söz ailesinde köy, köyler veya bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar için kaydedilmiş ayrı kullanımlar da bulunur.

facets.statement: İnsanlardan uzak, pek uğranmayan veya geçilmeyen arazi.
Köy, köyler ve uzak yerlerin halkı aynı söz ailesinin ayrı yer ve topluluk kullanımlarıdır.
Mezar anlamı tek kaynaklı aktarım içinde verilen ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanlardan uzak arazi anlamında birleşir; toplu kanıt ayrıca köy, köylerin halkı ve mezar anlamlarını ortak çekirdekten ayrılması gereken sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.

concept_gloss.text: uzak arazi; köy, uzak yer halkı veya mezar
concept_gloss.applicability: Ana uzak arazi anlamını öne alır ve kaynakta aynı dalda tutulan ayrı yer kullanımlarını açıkça işaretler.

error_profile.preserves: Uzak arazi çekirdeğini; köy, uzak yer halkı ve mezar varyantlarından ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz öbeğinin pek uğranmayan uzak araziyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklık ve insan uğrağından yoksunluk özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Köy, halk ve mezar kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal insanlardan uzak araziyi öne çıkarır ve köy ile mezarı ayrı sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü sınırlı yeri; mamur, boş, yerleşik veya ıssız oluşuna bakmadan genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Arazi, köy ve mezar gibi yer gönderimleri iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli sözlük gönderimlerine ve uzaklık koşuluna bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği genel yer kavramıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın ana yeri insanlardan uzak arazidir; ayrıca köy ve mezar kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir yer adı yanında deniz içindeki veya karadan kopuk adayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsan yerleşiminden ya da ana karadan ayrılık düşüncesi iki dalı yakınlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uzaklık insanlarla ilişkilidir; komşu dalda fiziksel kopukluk ve ada yapısı belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yer kavramı ile fiziksel kopuk yer, uzaklık koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافر من الأرض البعيد عن الناس والكفور للقرى والكفر للقرية والقبر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الثنايا من الجبال ولا البحر ولا الليل ولا الزرع
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفر من الأرض ما بعد من الناس وأهل الكفور والقرى (maqayis)؛ الكافر من الأرض ما بعد عن الناس والكفور القرى (ayn)؛ الكفر أيضا القرية والكفر أيضا القبر (sihah)؛ الكافر من الأرض ما بعد عن الناس (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dağ geçitlerini, iri bir dağı ve alçak duvarı aynı söz ailesinde sıralar; geçitleri 'örtülü' saymak kaynakta kurucu bir koşul değildir. Dal bu nedenle örtülülük altında birleştirilmeden coğrafi çekirdek ve ayrı duvar kullanımı olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dağ geçidi ve iri dağ coğrafi facetlerdir; alçak duvar ayrı bir sözlük varyantıdır, köy veya uzak arazi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimleri ayrı tutulur; uzak yer veya genel örtme anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dağlar arasındaki geçitler veya iri bir dağ için kullanılan coğrafi bir adlandırmadır; aynı söz ailesinde alçak duvar anlamı da ayrı bir sözlük kullanımı olarak kaydedilir.

facets.statement: Dağlar arasındaki geçit veya geçitler.
İri bir dağ, coğrafi alan içindeki ayrı bir kaynak varyantıdır.
Alçak duvar, coğrafi çekirdekten ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların çoğu dağ geçitlerini verir; toplu kanıt iri dağ ve alçak duvar anlamlarını da aynı söz ailesinin ayrı varyantları olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: dağ geçidi; iri dağ veya alçak duvar
concept_gloss.applicability: Dağ geçidi çekirdeğini öne alırken aynı dalda korunan iki ayrı sözlük varyantını da eksiltmeden gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimlerini birbirinden ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul veya tekil biçimin dağlar arasındaki geçidi gösterdiği coğrafi bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağlık arazideki geçit gönderimini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal dağ geçidi yanında iri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geçidi özellikle dağ veya vadideki yol kıvrımı ve yürünür güzergâh olarak tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazideki geçit iki dalın ortak gönderimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Geçit gönderiminde yakınlık yüksektir; ancak komşu dal yolun kıvrım ve güzergâh yapısını, bu dal ise ayrı dağ ve duvar varyantlarını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçidin yalnızca dağlık yer türünü adlandırır ve zorluk koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dik, engebeli ve çıkılması güç bir dağ yolunu veya benzer yükseltileri merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazide geçiş sağlayan yer iki dalda da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeğinde sarplık veya tırmanış şartı yoktur; komşu dalda güç çıkılan yükselen yol belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel dağ geçidi ile sarp dağ yolu, geçit türünün ve zorluk koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başla işaret etme ile eli göğse koyup bedenini alçaltmayı, başka birine boyun eğme gösterisinin iki bedensel gerçekleşmesi olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel içsel alçakgönüllülük değil, baş veya el ve gövdeyle yapılan belirli bir boyun eğme gösterisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem adı belirli bedensel boyun eğme hareketleriyle sınırlanır; günah giderme veya kişiyi inançsız sayma anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla işaret etmesi veya bir kişinin elini göğsüne koyup bedenini alçaltması yoluyla başka birine boyun eğdiğini göstermesidir.

facets.statement: Bedeni alçaltan bir hareketle başka birine boyun eğme gösterisi yapma.
Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla işaret etmesi veya bir kişinin elini göğsüne koyup eğilmesi, bu gösterinin belirtilen bedensel biçimleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başka birine bedensel olarak boyun eğme çekirdeğinde birleşir; başla işaret ve eli göğse koyarak eğilme iki farklı hareket biçimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tutumdan çok baş, el ve gövdeyle yapılan belirli gösteriyi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel eğilmeyi, yöneldiği kişiyi ve boyun eğme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla boyun eğmesi
contextual_glosses.applicability: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla boyun eğme işareti yaptığı tarihî bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla yaptığı boyun eğme işaretini korur.
error_profile.loses: Elin göğse konduğu ve bütün bedenin alçaldığı biçimi dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: başını eğmek veya elini göğsüne koyup eğilmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal başla işaret veya eli göğse koyup eğilme gibi belirli bir kişiye yönelmiş hareketleri şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal içsel alçalışı, ses ve bakışın sakinleşmesini, ibadet duruşunu ve genel gönüllü boyun eğmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Başın ve bedenin alçaltılmasıyla boyun eğme iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli törensel beden hareketidir; komşu dal daha geniş bir içsel ve dışsal alçakgönüllülük alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda alnı yere koymak şart değildir; baş işareti veya göğüste elle eğilme yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal alnı yere koymayı ve secde biçimindeki boyun eğmeyi de çekirdeğe alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bedeni alçaltarak itaat ve saygı gösterme iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Hareketin biçimi farklıdır: bu dal ayakta yapılan eğilme işaretlerini, komşu dal yere kapanmaya kadar uzanan secdeyi kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel alçakgönüllülük ve yere kapanma, bu dalın belirli beden hareketi sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.

branches.source_phrase_ar: التكفير إيماء الذمي برأسه لا يقال سجد له وإنما يقال كفر له (ayn)؛ التكفير أن يخضع الإنسان لغيره يضع يده على صدره ويتطامن له (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem hükümdara taç giydirme işlemini hem de bu işlemde kullanılan tacın kendisini açıkça verir; ancak geçici dal imgesindeki tacın örttüğü düşüncesi bir kaynak iddiası değildir. Süreç ve nesne ayrımı korunarak aynı dalda gösterilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hükümdarlık tacı ve taç giydirme töreniyle sınırlıdır; genel baş örtüsü veya boyun eğme hareketi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem adının taç giydirme süreci ve taç nesnesi gönderimleri birlikte fakat ayrı facetlerde korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hükümdarın başına taç koyarak onu taçlandırma işlemidir; aynı söz bu işlemde kullanılan tacın kendisini de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir hükümdarın başına taç koyarak onu taçlandırma işlemi.
Taçlandırma işleminde kullanılan tacın kendisi için aktarılan nesne anlamı.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı kanıt, hükümdarı taçlandırma süreci ile bu süreçte kullanılan taç nesnesini aynı sözün iki bağlı gönderimi olarak kaydeder.

source_details.summary: Söz hem hükümdara taç giydirme işlemi hem de bu işlemde kullanılan tacın adı olarak aktarılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Öfke durumuna girmeyi yalın ve şiddet derecesi belirtmeden bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Öfkenin kabarmasını kalıplaşmış ve görüntülü bir anlatımla verir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin öfke durumuna girmesi ve öfkesinin harekete geçmesi ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal doğrudan öfkelenmeyi bildirir; komşu dal aynı durumu öfkenin kabarmasını anlatan özel bir söz kalıbıyla görünür kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Öfkenin şiddeti veya dışa vurumu hakkında ek bir koşul koymaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin karşısındakine şiddetle yönelen yoğun öfkesini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin öfkelenmesi iki dalın ortak duygu değişimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal şiddet bakımından yansızdır; komşu dal öfkenin yoğunluğunu ve karşıdakine sert biçimde yönelmesini anlamın parçası yapar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiyi belirli bir işten veya girişimden uzaklaştırma eylemini ve bunun yumuşak biçimde yapılması koşulunu birlikte verir. Yumuşaklık, genel geri çevirme anlamından ayrılan kurucu bir sınırdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kişiyi bir işten yumuşakça çevirme yapısıyla sınırlıdır; her türlü engelleme veya yön değiştirmeyi kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kişi, uzaklaştırılan iş ve yumuşak davranma koşulunu birlikte taşıyan kanıtlanmış yapıya bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi belirli bir işten veya girişimden kırmadan ve yumuşak davranarak vazgeçirip uzaklaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, yöneldiği belirli bir işten yumuşak davranılarak vazgeçirilir ve uzaklaştırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için kaynaklar arası ortaklaştırılabilecek ayrı bir açıklama yoktur; yumuşakça vazgeçirme yapısı tek kaynak ayrıntısıdır.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak, bir kişiyi belirli bir işten yumuşak davranarak vazgeçirip uzaklaştırma anlamını kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin yöneldiği belirli işten sertlik göstermeden çevrilip vazgeçirildiği yapının bütün koşullarını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi, uzaklaştırılan işi, vazgeçirme eylemini ve yumuşak davranma koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Geçmiş zamanlı bir bağlamda bir kişinin belirli bir işten kırmadan uzaklaştırıldığı anlatımda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Etkilenen kişiyi, belirli işi ve yumuşak vazgeçirme biçimini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişiyi belirli bir işten çevirirken yumuşak davranmayı zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi veya kişiyi herhangi bir nesneden geri çevirir; yumuşaklık ve iş bağlamı zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi yöneldiği şeyden geri çevirip uzaklaştırma eylemi ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir işten vazgeçirmeyi ve yumuşak davranmayı birlikte gerektirir; komşu dal daha genel bir geri çevirme eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan hedefini, belirli bir işi ve kırmadan davranma koşulunu birlikte taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesnelerin yönünü değiştirme ile insanı doğru, inanç veya iyilikten uzaklaştırma gibi geniş alanlara yayılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişi veya şeyin yöneldiği doğrultudan başka yana çevrilmesi ortak alandır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir kişiyi belirli bir işten yumuşakça vazgeçirmeye bağlıdır; komşu dal nesne ve insanları farklı yönlerden çeviren daha geniş bir anlam taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin belirli bir işi bırakması ve o işten uzaklaşması hedeflenir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişiyi idare etme, gönlünü hoş tutma veya onunla örtülü biçimde geçinme anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Başka bir kişiye karşı sertlik göstermeden davranma biçiminde kesişirler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın sonucu kişinin bir işten vazgeçmesidir; komşu dalda davranış yumuşaktır fakat kişiyi bir işten döndürme sonucu zorunlu değildir.
